target_customer: Product managers and product teams at software companies that want interactive prototypes of new features built on top of their real product UI
problem: Product managers can plan features but lack a fast way to show them in the real product without designers or engineers, so ideas are validated slowly with static mockups.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free tier and paid pro plans

founders.name: Simon Kubica
founders.background_notes: Product leader at Atlassian on Jira, Forge and new products per the YC page. Education not found.

founders.name: Christian Iacullo
founders.background_notes: Software engineer at Canva on the Editor, Developer Platform, Education and Collaboration, started at Atlassian on Confluence per the YC page. Education not found.

competitors.name: Magic Patterns
competitors.what: AI design and prototyping tool for product teams, also a YC W23 company

technical_complexity.rationale: Cloning live product pages via a browser extension and generating faithful interactive prototypes with LLMs was standard engineering with hard parts in DOM capture and design fidelity; the later cloud agent connecting to codebases adds more.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI prototyping tools appeared from 2024 onward and the capture approach is copyable; some lock-in from stored product libraries and codebase connections.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not verified from sources. The vendor positions itself against Figma and generic AI app builders, and many AI prototyping tools launched after 2023.

market_need_then: The team's own framing is that PMs could plan features but had no quick way to validate them; the original Index product was product planning and the prototyping focus came later. No independent demand data found.

branding.domain_note: Operated at index.inc under the earlier name and alloy.app after the rename; acquisition details not found.

identity.logo: App icon only, no mascot shown on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct and action oriented, for example prompt, share and push production-ready code

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources found; Alloy launched as the prototyping product on 2025-09-01 by the Index team

branding.community_and_virality: Named SaaStr AI App of the Week in October 2025 and Proddy Award top prototyping product in December 2025 per search summaries; no merch or fan communities found.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand-specific coverage; both names are common English words shared with unrelated companies (an identity decisioning company named Alloy, a robotics data startup named Alloy).

pivots.from: Index, a product planning tool for product managers
pivots.to: Alloy, an AI prototyping tool built from a live product
pivots.why: Team saw PMs could plan but not validate features quickly (per vendor material, not independently verified)

outcome_analysis: Alloy, formerly Index, is active and raised a seed round of A$3.5M in February 2025 led by Blackbird and Bain Capital Ventures, then relaunched as an AI prototyping product in September 2025. Early signs include trade awards, but independent traction data is absent and it faces a crowded field of AI prototyping tools.
notes: Seed reported as A$3.5M (Australian outlets, Blackbird) versus USD in some aggregators and over $2M in Business Insider; the USD amount is left null. Valuation reported around A$30M in one source summary only, so not recorded. Rename date inferred from product launch date; no explanation found. Unrelated companies named Alloy exist.
